name: Exp_WPRSIsignal
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom WPRSIsignal indicator, which combines WPR (Williams Percent Range) and RSI into a momentum oscillator. It opens buy positions on upward momentum signals and sell positions on downward momentum signals, with configurable position closing and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义WPRSIsignal指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标将WPR（威廉指标）和RSI组合成动量振荡器。它在上涨动量信号时开多仓，在下跌动量信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的平仓和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于WPRSIsignal自定义指标，该指标融合了威廉百分比范围（WPR）和相对强弱指数（RSI）的动量信号。入场条件为：当指标的上行缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号柱上产生非零且非空值时，开多仓；当指标的下行缓冲区（buffer 0）产生信号时，开空仓。出场条件包括：当出现反向信号时平仓（例如上行信号触发多仓平仓），以及通过StopLoss和TakeProfit参数设置的固定止损止盈。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比和基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理采用MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手或10%比例。EA还包含一个历史回溯机制，当同时启用开仓和平仓且当前无平仓信号时，会回溯历史柱寻找反向信号以确定是否需要平仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on the WPRSIsignal custom indicator, which combines Williams Percent Range (WPR) and Relative Strength Index (RSI) momentum signals into a unified oscillator. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upward buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar; a sell position is opened when the downward buffer (buffer 0) produces a signal. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals (e.g., an upward signal triggers closing of sell positions) and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels set via StopLoss_ and TakeProfit_ parameters. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MMMode parameter, including fixed lot size, percentage of balance, and percentage of free margin. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk proportion, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 10% ratio. The EA also includes a historical lookback mechanism that scans previous bars for reverse signals when both opening and closing are enabled but no close signal exists on the current bar.

parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于动量指标组合信号，入场条件明确
支持多种资金管理模式（固定手数、余额百分比、可用保证金百分比），灵活度高
提供独立的开仓和平仓开关，可以灵活控制交易方向和退出行为
包含止损止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制机制
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on combined momentum indicator signals with well-defined entry conditions
Supports multiple money management modes (fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage) offering high flexibility
Independent switches for opening and closing positions allow granular control over trade direction and exit behavior
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings providing basic risk control mechanisms
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标WPRSIsignal，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
止损止盈使用固定点数而非ATR等动态指标，在不同波动率环境下适应性差
历史回溯平仓机制（扫描所有历史柱）在长历史数据下可能导致性能问题
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有最大持仓数量限制，可能在连续信号时过度开仓
注释为乱码（编码问题），严重影响代码可读性和维护性
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator WPRSIsignal; EA fails to run if the indicator file is missing
Stop-loss and take-profit use fixed point values rather than dynamic indicators like ATR, resulting in poor adaptability across different volatility environments
Historical lookback close mechanism (scanning all historical bars) may cause performance issues with long price history
Lacks spread filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No maximum position count limit, potentially over-opening on consecutive signals
Comments are garbled (encoding issues), severely impacting code readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈替代固定点数，提高对不同市场波动率的适应性
添加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，增强风险控制
优化历史回溯平仓逻辑，设置最大回溯柱数限制以避免性能问题
修复源文件编码问题，将乱码注释恢复为可读的中文或英文注释
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to replace fixed point values, improving adaptability to different market volatility
Add spread filter and maximum position count limits to enhance risk control
Optimize historical lookback close logic by setting a maximum lookback bar limit to avoid performance issues
Fix source file encoding issues and restore garbled comments to readable Chinese or English

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失导致EA初始化失败
固定点数止损止盈在不同品种和波动率环境下风险不对称
历史回溯平仓机制可能因循环无上限导致延迟或卡顿
无点差过滤在高成本交易环境下增加滑点风险
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator; missing indicator causes EA initialization failure
Fixed point stop-loss/take-profit creates asymmetric risk across different instruments and volatility regimes
Historical lookback close mechanism without loop limits may cause delay or lag
No spread filter increases slippage risk in high-cost trading environments
